spans.s: --a son of Asura Andhaka; to wreak vengeance on शिव for having slain his father, he entered the harem of शिव in the guise of a snake, and assumed the guise of उमा before him. He could change his form twice as he liked owing to a boon from ब्रह्मा; but the second change would be followed by death. On close examination, शिव dis- covered the figure to be the Asura in disguise, threw the Vajra and slew him. M. १५६. १२-37. [page१-151+ ३०]
